text_block_list.text:
Enthusiastic cheers usher in Super
Creek's
conquest of the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Following the race, Супер Крик rewards
me by
gleefully praising me as a way of
expressing her
gratitude.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With a flood of emotions, she holds me
in a tight
embrace.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Through her care, I've become a
top-class trainer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
